.dv-big{transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:dvBig .28s steps(3) infinite alternate}.c-devil .dv-low{transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:dvLow 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}.c-devil .dv-up{animation:dvUp 2s ease-out infinite}.c-devil .dv-d{animation-delay:.7s}.c-devil .dv-blink{animation:dvBlink .7s linear infinite}.c-devil .dv-jab{animation:dvJab .5s ease-in infinite alternate}.c-devil .dv-fall{animation:dvFall 2.2s ease-in infinite}@keyframes dvFl{from{transform:scale(.92,1)}to{transform:scale(1.06,1.12)}}@keyframes dvBig{from{transform:scale(1.2,1.3)}to{transform:scale(1.4,1.55)}}@keyframes dvLow{0%,100%{opacity:.55}50%{opacity:1}}@keyframes dvUp{0%{transform:translateY(4px);opacity:0}25%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(-22px);opacity:0}}@keyframes dvBlink{0%,49%{opacity:1}50%,100%{opacity:.15}}@keyframes dvJab{from{transform:translateY(-6px)}to{transform:translateY(5px)}}@keyframes dvFall{0%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(14px);opacity:0}}@keyframes dvTail{from{transform:rotate(-13deg)}to{transform:rotate(13deg)}}@keyframes dvHop{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}40%{transform:translateY(-12px)}}@keyframes dvShake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}25%{transform:translateX(-3px)}75%{transform:translateX(3px)}}@keyframes dvLean{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}50%{transform:rotate(-3deg) scale(1.03)}}@keyframes dvBreath{0%,100%{transform:translateY(3px)}50%{transform:translateY(6px)}}@keyframes dvBoop{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}30%{transform:scale(1.07,.9)}}.c-devil:not(.s-idle) .whole{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}.c-devil:not(.s-idle) .tTail{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:0 100%}.c-devil.s-think .tTail{animation:dvTail 1.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.c-devil.s-work .tTail{animation:dvTail .3s linear infinite alternate}.c-devil.s-wait .tTail{animation:dvTail .45s steps(2) infinite alternate}.c-devil.s-happy .tTail{animation:dvTail .25s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.c-devil.s-alert .tTail{transform:rotate(-24deg)}.c-devil.s-sad .tTail{transform:rotate(42deg)}.c-devil.s-sleep .tTail{transform:rotate(30deg) scale(.85)}.c-devil.s-busy .tTail{animation:dvTail .12s linear infinite alternate}.c-devil.s-boop .tTail{animation:dvTail .2s ease-out 3 alternate}.c-devil.s-wait .whole{animation:dvLean 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}.c-devil.s-happy .whole{animation:dvHop .75s ease-in-out infinite}.c-devil.s-alert .whole{animation:dvShake .2s linear infinite}.c-devil.s-sad .whole{transform:rotate(4deg) translateY(7px)}.c-devil.s-sleep .whole{animation:dvBreath 4.5s ease-in-out infinite}.c-devil.s-boop .whole{animation:dvBoop .6s ease-out}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.c-devil [class*=dv-],.c-devil:not(.s-idle) .whole,.c-devil:not(.s-idle) .tTail{animation:none}}

notes: Each character acts through its own hardware: Snowflake's lambda crown gains an orbiting ring of glass shards, Terminal's screen plays real shell states, Robot speaks in segmented visor LEDs and steam, and Devil schemes with his tail, a hard-edged flame and a trident. All shapes are crisp with hard-stop highlights, face art stays clear of Nixi's eyes, and the only existing parts moved are .whole, .tCursor, .tAntenna and .tTail.
